description.value: Tetsu Sushi Bar is a Michelin Guide-recommended omakase restaurant in Vancouver's West End, operated by Chef Satoshi Makise since 2017. With only 12 seats and a focus on Edomae-style nigiri made from fish sourced directly from Tokyo's Toyosu Market, it ranked 47th on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants list in 2022. A touring cyclist planning a special evening meal will find an intimate, chef-driven experience unlike anything else on the Denman Street corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website comprehensively confirms this is an intimate 12-seat omakase sushi restaurant at 775 Denman Street, open Tuesday–Sunday evenings by reservation only. The contact page mentions only 'Paid Public Street Parking Nearby' — no bike racks or cycling infrastructure are referenced anywhere on the site. The menu page explicitly states that vegetarian, gluten-free, no-rice, and soy-allergy dietary restrictions 'cannot be accommodated,' providing clear negative evidence for that amenity.
concerns: Restaurant is open evenings only (Tue–Sun) and is reservation-required via Tock, making drop-in use by touring cyclists impractical.
Only 12 seats; walk-in availability is extremely limited.
No bike parking of any kind mentioned on the website; contact page references only 'Paid Public Street Parking Nearby.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tetsu is a dinner-only, reservation-required omakase restaurant with 12 seats and no evidence of cyclist-friendly infrastructure; it cannot accommodate common dietary restrictions. It sits on a cycling-friendly street and would appeal to a cyclist planning a special evening, but its reservation-only model and very limited capacity make it a poor fit as a spontaneous touring stop — human review should decide whether the directory targets pre-planned fine dining.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone number (604-428-5775) and full postal address (V6G 2L6) are confirmed by the website but were absent from OSM tags — added from website content.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu page states: 'certain dietary restrictions, such as vegetarian, gluten-free and no rice requests, and soy allergies cannot be accommodated.'
